entry_points.text: Control plane creates control file under dynamic-debug directory in debugfs and procfs with dedicated vectors.

exports.text: Bounded exact table lookup with early stop, wildcard match with single and span markers plus backtracking, first-substring search, duplication with byte replacement, and capped terminating formatting.
Strict unsigned conversion with plus, radix, overflow and garbage handling; buffer scanning with blanks, signs, widths, suppression, length report, sets and literals; fault tuning parses four fields.
Heap sort no-ops small inputs, picks exchange by alignment and width, builds heap then extracts with yield; extable shares overflow-safe ordering for sort and search and trims init ends.
Errseq records via compare-exchange bumping only if observed, with sample, check and advancing check in error, flag and counter layout; injection ranges support membership and kind lookup.
Queue limits adapt on backlog and slack with clamping, reset to minimum at now, and init bounds; early archive validates newc headers and regular-file prefix returning data, size and remainder.
Dynamic debug pr, device, netdevice and bus-device reports with parent and null fallbacks, plus class param ops and module-param callback to shared dispatch.

hazards.text: Parsers mutate inputs in place requiring writable buffers; malformed control, flags, lines, overflow or missing storage fail closed; missing descriptors are fatal.

One query allows nine words; query and prefix buffers are 128 bytes with safe truncation; control bound is 4096 with max write one less; nodes use owner-rw perms; header shows location, module, func, flags, format.

Archive length follows field count with two magic values, needs regular-file mode and four-byte alignment, warns and truncates long remainders else empty; removal uses pointer identity; over-completion is fatal; failed writes keep offset.
Alloc failure leaves prior entries while skipping bad addresses; zero or oversized error warns and keeps state; sets treat dashes literally, need width and reject discard-with-set.
Decoding, exchange, alignment, word-width and test reschedule have build variants; kinds render as short labels with unknown fallback.
External logging, sync, barrier, device, time, alloc, seq, debugfs, proc, notifier, kallsyms and module facilities are interface only.

invariants.text: Flags render in glyph order with placeholder if none; diagnostics gate on levels one to four with query logging; outvar is empty annotation; KP_NAME exposes param names.
Class lookup tests half-open base-length intervals deriving id from base plus offset; bitmap apply synthesizes per-class queries; temp buffer is fixed small size.

Keyword selectors with file colon and escapes; line empty, single and dash range; flags replace, set, clear; quoted tokenize; change filters by module, class, paths, func, format and lines; per-site merges bits; exec applies and batch continues.
Class lists take optional sign, normalize newlines, skip unknown, toggle disjoint bits and recompute levels; numeric input masks bits and clamps levels with warnings; readout renders hex or decimal.

Prefixes budget into fixed buffer with remaining helper, add thread or interrupt identity plus location with separator, guarantee termination with fast skip; listing shows escaped site line with flags, class and header.

Control write rejects oversize and advances offset only on success; iteration walks tables down; seq start locks; module add stores ranges and maps; param dispatch splits keys with default query; boot setup consumes.
Gap helpers give positive difference and after-or-equal; base error table indexes by positive number with dash names; extended table covers 512-550 via base subtract.

Population resolves descriptors, skips bad addresses, appends range records with kind and owner; load appends advertised funcs and unload removes by owner; usercopy fault has boot parse and debug expose.

locks.text: One mutex guards debug tables: change holds over scan, seq start acquires and stop releases, add, remove and remove-all hold around linkage.
Injection mutex guards list with seq start acquiring and stop releasing; stall sampling uses once reads, barriers and retry on head change.

state_machines.text: Listing opens cursor and repeats start, next, show under lock with header first; module events add or remove tables; builtin init groups descriptors, replays boot queries and clears on failure.

Limit rises when over-limit drains, falls only after sustained slack beyond hold using minimum seen, else holds within bounds; stall check is inert at zero threshold else counts one stall and advances marker.

Errseq cycles unobserved, observed, re-recorded bumping generation on new record after observation; module arrival populates and departure removes; bring-up populates kernel descriptors, registers notifier then creates listing.

structs.text: Wiring exposes seq ops start, next, show, stop, file ops open, read, seek, release, write, parallel proc vector, and module notifier with default priority.
Injection iteration wires start, next, stop, show with locked traversal; record holds list link, address range, error kind and owner.
Table carries module name, descriptor range and class-map list; cursor carries table pointer plus index across tables.
Class map has name list, length, base, type with param bits or level; limiter has limits, counts, snapshots, slack, stall history; archive result has data, size, name buffer and field enum.
